text:
marco: FYI seeing repeat failures when doing SCIM full-sync for a few orgs. Errors look like SAML/OIDC handshake fails then a KMS decrypt error. Sample logs below.

elaine: can you paste the log lines? also which idp? okta or internal?

marco: okta. log:
```
2026-03-23T15:12:34Z idp-proxy error: jwe_decrypt: invalid_aad: failed to unwrap envelope for extid=org-123
2026-03-23T15:12:34Z scim-sync warn: provisioner: upstream 502 from idp-proxy
```

sam: @elaine @marco odd — invalid_aad usually means mismatch in AAD payload used during KMS envelope wrap. Did we recently roll KMS key or change RBAC for the provisioner service account?

marco: we rolled a small RBAC change yesterday to restrict "provisioner" SA; rollout doc: link_to_runbook

elaine: hmm can you quickly check audit logs for kms:Decrypt on the KMS key? maybe the provisioner lost kms:Decrypt permission. Also check if the encryption context changed (expect extid or tenant-id)

marco: checked cloud audit: Decrypt returns DENIED for principal serviceAccount:infra/provisioner@redwood. It worked earlier in the day then started DENIED at 15:12.

security-oncall: Incident bot: creating INC-2026-148 (priority P1) — SCIM sync failures for multiple customers. Paging oncall.

sam: rollback RBAC now? If the SA lost kms:Decrypt it definitely explains the JWE unwrap failure.

elaine: quick mitigation: we can add a temporary deny-exception to allow kms:Decrypt for that SA for the key's IAM policy while we triage. Also restart idp-proxy pods to flush any cached token/AAD.

marco: applied temporary IAM allow for kms:Decrypt to key/alias/provisioner-key. Restarted idp-proxy; SCIM syncs resumed for org-123, org-456.

elaine: follow-up action items: 1) root cause: RBAC policy change inadvertently removed key binding in infra PR 587. 2) restore principle of least privilege but ensure key-binding automated tests cover KMS decrypt for provisioner. 3) add audit alert to detect sudden DENIED spikes on kms:Decrypt for provisioner principal. 4) add more verbose audit logs for envelope headers.

sam: filing followup GH issues. also verify KMS key rotation didn't produce multiple key versions with different AAD expectations.

marco: confirmed no key rotation at that time. It was purely IAM policy change. closing out after monitoring for 30m :thumbsup:

elaine: adding final note to runbook: 'When adding/removing RBAC rules for service accounts, run kms-policy-checker and restart provisioner components to pick up policy change'

idp-monitor-bot: monitor: scim-sync-latency back to normal; no new DENIED events in last 20m.

elaine: thanks all, great catch. Will retro with security + infra on lessons and add audit rule. :heart:
